about: Bootloaders the Rockchip boards page writes to a Lyra's onboard SPI NAND (irate_box/root/rkboard.py). The files are not shipped: stage them in <state>/rk-bootloaders/<id>/ with a SHA256SUMS beside them. The offsets are the tested RK3506 NAND layout: idbloader.img at 0 and 4 MiB, u-boot.itb at 8 MiB, the rescue FIT at 12 MiB and the UBI rescue at 32 MiB.

source.nand-uboot: Kwiboo c6782a3 with the SPI-NAND SPL patches (05/15 and 06/15) and the Stage 0b changes, built 2026-11-05
source.stock: the bootloader Luckfox ships with the Lyra Zero W

bootloaders.title: Original bootloader
bootloaders.summary: The bootloader Luckfox ships with the Lyra Zero W. Its files are not in irate-box: put them in rk-bootloaders/stock with their SHA256SUMS.

bootloaders.title: irate-box NAND U-Boot and Alpine rescue (C)
bootloaders.summary: The NAND U-Boot whose SPL loads U-Boot proper from the SPI NAND, plus the Alpine rescue in its UBI volume. It boots the card first, then USB, then C. Installing it erases the whole flash and lays out the proven 2026-11-05 chain, so the board is standalone.
